skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply advanced techniques in digital image processing, including image acquisition, enhancement, segmentation, and recognition.
Utilize Python for implementing image processing algorithms and solving complex image-related problems.
Apply machine learning techniques for image recognition tasks.
Develop problem-solving skills to address complex image processing challenges.
Work effectively in teams to complete image processing projects.
Demonstrate the ability to independently learn and apply new concepts in image processing.
Analyze and evaluate image processing techniques and their applications.
